title: Subject Matter
slide_intent: Develop a story from the purpose of an illustration. A familiar idea can become easier to remember when the image gives it a specific action or surprise.
strategic_value: Instacart can communicate delivery, variety and savings with a point of view that belongs to its illustrated world.
demonstration: Rows link a communication need to two treatments. For quick delivery, a lightning bolt gives way to sneakers with fire behind them. For delivery itself, a bag on a doorstep becomes a hand pressing a doorbell.
practical_value: Write the communication need first, then compare a literal symbol with an action that conveys the same idea more vividly.

content_islands.name: Reading key
content_islands.spec: Keep the introduction to the left of the table. Label the three main columns by need, literal depiction and preferred story.

content_islands.name: Conversion rows
content_islands.spec: Align the rejected and preferred concepts with the need they answer. Use a thin arrow between alternatives and group multi-line examples under Benefits and How-tos.
